stages.name: frozen_decorated
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT d.__path,d.decorated FROM py_decorations d JOIN py_callees f ON f.__path=d.__path AND f.call=d.call
 JOIN py_keyword_arguments a ON a.__path=d.__path AND a.call=d.call JOIN py_keyword_arguments b ON b.__path=d.__path AND b.call=d.call
 WHERE (f.kind='identifier' AND f.name='dataclass' OR f.kind='attribute' AND f.attribute='dataclass')
 AND a.name='frozen' AND a.value='True' AND b.name='slots' AND b.value='True'

stages.name: classes
stages.query:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,name ORDER BY __start DESC) AS selected FROM (
 SELECT c.__path,c.__start,c.__end,CASE WHEN z.decorated IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE c.__start END AS frozen,c.name FROM py_definitions c
 LEFT JOIN frozen_decorated z ON z.__path=c.__path AND z.decorated=c.decorated WHERE c.kind='class_definition' AND c.outer IS NULL)) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: symbols
stages.query:
SELECT __path,name FROM classes UNION SELECT __path,name FROM py_definitions WHERE kind='function_definition' AND container_kind='module'
 UNION SELECT __path,name FROM py_assignments WHERE parent_kind='expression_statement' AND container_kind='module' AND name IS NOT NULL

stages.name: members
stages.query:
SELECT a.__path,a.__start,a.__end,a.name,c.__start AS owner,a.type FROM py_assignments a JOIN py_definitions c ON c.__path=a.__path AND c.body=a.container
 WHERE a.kind='assignment' AND a.name IS NOT NULL AND a.parent_kind='expression_statement' AND a.container_kind='block' AND c.kind='class_definition' AND c.outer IS NULL

stages.name: method_defs
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.__start,f.__end,f.name,c.__start AS owner FROM py_definitions f JOIN py_definitions c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.body=f.container
 WHERE f.kind='function_definition' AND f.container_kind='block' AND c.kind='class_definition' AND c.outer IS NULL

stages.name: methods
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,owner,name ORDER BY __start DESC) AS selected FROM method_defs) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: annotations
stages.query:
SELECT t.__path,t.__start,t.__end,m.name AS field,t.name,m.owner FROM py_annotation_tokens t JOIN members m ON m.__path=t.__path AND m.__start=t.annotated
 WHERE t.annotated_kind='assignment'

stages.name: returns
stages.query:
SELECT t.__path,t.__start,t.__end,m.owner AS class,m.name AS method,t.name,m.__start AS owner FROM py_annotation_tokens t
 JOIN method_defs m ON m.__path=t.__path AND m.__start=t.returns

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT t.__path,t.__start,t.__end,m.owner AS class,m.name AS method,t.name,m.__start AS owner FROM py_annotation_tokens t
 JOIN py_typed_parameters p ON p.__path=t.__path AND p.__start=t.annotated JOIN method_defs m ON m.__path=p.__path AND m.__start=p.function
 WHERE t.annotated_kind IN ('typed_parameter','typed_default_parameter') AND p.splat IS NULL

stages.name: bases
stages.query:
SELECT t.__path,t.__start,t.__end,t.name,t.class AS owner FROM py_base_tokens t JOIN py_definitions c ON c.__path=t.__path AND c.__start=t.class
 WHERE t.keyword IS NULL AND c.kind='class_definition' AND c.outer IS NULL

stages.name: union_names
stages.query:
SELECT t.__path,t.__start,t.__end,a.name AS alias,t.name FROM py_assigned_tokens t JOIN py_assignments a ON a.__path=t.__path AND a.__start=t.assignment
 WHERE a.container_kind='module' AND a.name IS NOT NULL

SELECT path,0 AS start_byte,0 AS end_byte,symbol,issue,requirement FROM (
 SELECT r.path,r.name AS symbol,'SPTA001' AS issue,'symbol' AS requirement FROM required_symbols r
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM symbols s WHERE s.__path=r.path AND s.name=r.name)
 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT r.path,r.class,'SPTA013','fields' FROM required_fields r JOIN classes c ON c.__path=r.path AND c.name=r.class
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM members f WHERE f.__path=r.path AND f.owner=c.__start AND f.name=r.name AND f.type IS NOT NULL)
 UNION ALL SELECT r.path,r.class,'SPTA013','immutable' FROM required_immutable r JOIN classes c ON c.__path=r.path AND c.name=r.class WHERE c.frozen IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT r.path,r.class,'SPTA013','enum' FROM required_enums r JOIN classes c ON c.__path=r.path AND c.name=r.class
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bases b WHERE b.__path=r.path AND b.owner=c.__start AND b.name='StrEnum')
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM members f WHERE f.__path=r.path AND f.owner=c.__start AND f.name=r.name AND f.type IS NULL)
 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT r.path,r.alias,'SPTA013','union' FROM required_unions r JOIN symbols s ON s.__path=r.path AND s.name=r.alias
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM union_names n WHERE n.__path=r.path AND n.alias=r.alias AND n.name=r.name)
 UNION ALL SELECT 'l2070_batching/step.py','ServerPlanStep.planning_contract','SPTA002','planning-method' WHERE NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM classes c JOIN methods m ON m.__path=c.__path AND m.owner=c.__start JOIN returns r ON r.__path=m.__path AND r.owner=m.__start
 WHERE c.__path='l2070_batching/step.py' AND c.name='ServerPlanStep' AND m.name='planning_contract' AND r.name='StepPlanningContract')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'l2070_batching/physical_placement.py','ApplicationPlacementUnit.application','SPTA003','application-field' WHERE NOT EXISTS(
